items.text: Lamar Jackson present for start of Thursday practice after limited Wednesday work; ankle progress after missing two games.
items.why: HC Minter noted limited Wed; present Thu start per Hensley/Schefter/Rapoport
items.implication: Boosts chance to play vs CIN; upgrades Flowers/Andrews if active

items.text: Saquon Barkley expected to return to practice Thursday and in line to play Monday vs Cowboys after hamstring (missed two games).
items.why: Sources via Garafolo/Rapoport; lift for banged-up Eagles backfield with Hurts out
items.implication: Immediate RB1 return value vs DAL

items.text: Terry McLaurin torn patellar tendon, out for season; Commanders offense fallout video breakdown.
items.why: Quinn confirmed torn tendon post-MNF; Schefter/Rapoport
items.implication: Removes WR1; Diggs/others elevate, Daniels downgrade
items.opportunity: Target share to Diggs, Okonkwo, Williams

items.text: Rams WR Davante Adams placed on IR with ruptured hamstring, expected out 6-10 weeks; procedure planned, hope return around Week 11 bye.
items.implication: Long-term absence removes WR1 production; drop in most redraft

items.text: Bears RB Kyle Monangai ruled OUT for TNF vs Patriots (thumb/turf toe); misses third straight, return coming soon.
items.why: Official injury report; Rapoport confirms return imminent
items.implication: Elevates other CHI RBs short-term for TNF

items.text: Giants will start JJ McCarthy at QB Sunday vs Texans, replacing Winston; confirmed by coach.
items.why: Fowler source + Harbaugh confirm via Schefter/Rapoport

items.text: With Adams IR and TE Terrance Ferguson recovery delayed beyond eligibility, Rams' only answer is 25 Puka Nacua targets per game.
items.why: Ferguson not ready soon per Schefter source; Adams gone 6-10 weeks
items.implication: Elite WR1 volume spike ROS even with defensive attention

items.text: Bhayshul Tuten usage keeps rising every week; passing-game usage stands out as why he is LEGIT.
Week 7 snaps/pace: TB@CAR up in pace (tempo notes, Mayfield return potential); MIA@NYJ slow-paced slogs. Other slate notes from Thorman.
items.why: Neutral pace/POE/PROE data; TB rising, MIA/NYJ low volume
items.implication: Favor high-pace for volume plays; avoid slogs
items.opportunity: Higher combined snaps TB/CAR, GB/DET, LAR/LV

items.text: Ollie Gordon found end zone three straight; KEEPING IT OPEN on Dolphins RB vs Jets Week 7.
Keeping it OPEN on Tony Pollard reluctantly; volume and bye weeks keep him low-end RB2/Flex.
Give me Caleb Williams in battle of 2024 first-round QBs on TNF.

items.implication: Potential efficiency drag if relevant connection

items.text: Bears post-Week 10 bye close vs soft defenses: Saints 27th YPP, Lions 24th, Jags 26th, Dolphins 21st, Bills 25th (Packers 3rd outlier). Season so far uneven with backups.
items.why: Favorable remaining schedule after bye; recent 31-pt output
items.implication: ROS boost for CHI skill players/QB
